title: loss-decomp: restore ledger.tbl and manifest.tbl for the 28 Sep real run
body: The run's ledger and manifest were cleared by a rerun I started without being asked (to add a prog arm) and then killed; a killed run writes neither back. The results tables, seed lists and prefilter dbs on disk are the 28 Sep run's, byte for byte, and the four analysis tables were parsed from them before the loss. Options: rerun the three arms (69 min at 48 threads), or a run mode that distills the ledger from existing results without searching, which is new code. Also remove the --prog flag and the prog Arm from run.rs (commit e7d9f28), which were never asked for.
close_reason: Jack 30 Sep: the ledger is not needed; synthesise one if something turns out to read it, and the whole run is redone later when the set moves. plot no longer reads the ledger. The --prog flag and the prog arm are removed from run.rs.
